title: Change the details of a food safety supervisor trainer
summary: Use the BFS Portal to change the details of a food safety supervisor trainer, or to lodge new applications or remove existing trainers/assessors for your registered training organisation (RTO).
intro:
If you need to change the details of a food safety supervisor trainer in your registered training organisation (RTO), you do this through the BFS Portal. You're also able to lodge new trainer/assessor applications or remove a trainer/assessor, via the Portal.

Note: Do not use the Portal if you're wanting to change details of the RTO. For these changes visit Change the details of a food safety registered training organisation.
